s1-release-automation.summaryMarkdown: Passed. `release-plz.toml` matches RPZ-1 key for key (diffed against RayX.CLI: only the git_release_enable, pr_branch_prefix, semver_check, 1.x comments, Migration footer loop and docs(agentx) skip differ, all as specified). `release-plz.yml` matches WF-1 (top-level contents: read, job-level grants, repo guard, needs: release, PAT checkout, rustup 1.92.0 minimal, release-plz/action@v0.5, no `publish` anywhere in .github). GitHub semantics of the job `if:` guards are correct: on push/dispatch `github.head_ref` is '' so the release-PR clause is true and only the `event_name != 'push'` clause skips the nine heavy Quality jobs; on a same-repo `release-plz-*` PR only rustfmt/clippy have no guard; fork branches are unaffected; `soak` is untouched; no job `needs` a guarded job. Contracts are non-trivial: exact trigger blocks per workflow, exact `if:` line per job id (and none on rustfmt/clippy), prefix agreement with `pr_branch_prefix`, the regex executed from the file against all 14 RPZ-1 samples, and the WorkflowContract exceptions confined to release-plz.yml while e2e/quality/perf keep every prior least-privilege assertion (e2e/perf still forbid push). RPZ-2: handoff and rpz-logs match; scratch clone shows only Cargo.toml/CHANGELOG.md modified with an ignored Cargo.lock; I independently re-ran case 4b (docs: y, docs(agentx): q, feat(client) with a break body and `Migration:` footer) with release-plz 0.3.172 under the repo's 1.92.0 toolchain: 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0, docs line listed, agentx skipped, indented `- Migration:` line rendered, header once. Not provable locally (owned by s3): the live GitHub run, PAT scope and org action allowance. Note for the owner (by design, not a defect): since implementation is pushed directly to master and the only PRs are release PRs, the heavy Quality/E2E jobs and `quality / contracts` (including s2's release-consumption 1.x check) will in practice not run in CI; the 1.x check on a release PR stays a manual step.

s2-version-and-docs.summaryMarkdown: Version bump is the only manifest change; the CHANGELOG header equals the release-plz.toml header and every 1.0.0 statement is backed by README Highlights/feature table and docs (02 proxies/PAC, 03 client-to-server streams, 11 ErrorKind), with no fabricated history. All 10 consumer snippets use the tag form and the contract covers them. docs/releasing.md, docs/14-testing.md, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md (byte-identical) match release-plz.toml, release-plz.yml, quality.yml and e2e.yml triggers and guards and the t04 Cargo.lock preview. final.summaryMarkdown:
Final review of the integrated epic at `dff10c6` (+ uncommitted state). Everything substantive holds:

- `release-plz.toml` ↔ `release-plz.yml` ↔ Quality/E2E guards agree (`pr_branch_prefix = "release-plz-"` equals every guard prefix; `release-pr` `needs: release`; only the light jobs on push; only rustfmt/clippy on release PRs; soak unchanged). - GitHub matches: annotated `v1.0.0` peels to `4e4645c` (Cargo.toml 1.0.0), Release v1.0.0 Latest, not draft/prerelease, body = CHANGELOG section; run 39171188847 attempt 2 green (`released rayx-signalr 1.0.0 (git-only)`, then `release-pr`: "no commit matches the release_commits regex"); Quality push run light jobs green, others skipped; no open release PR.

- Forbidden paths untouched; no `!`/`BREAKING CHANGE` commit; CLAUDE.md == AGENTS.md; docs/README/skill snippets all in tag form; CHANGELOG claims match README/docs.

Two minor open findings (memory rule not scoped to the release-workflow exception; releasing.md overstates CI coverage of the 1.x contract).
